buildCommand: npm run build && node scripts/check-auth-env.ts && npm run db:migrate
ignoreCommand: echo "an=$(git log -1 --format=%an) cn=$(git log -1 --format=%cn) env=$VERCEL_ENV"; [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = preview ] && [ "$(git log -1 --format=%cn)" = 'github-actions[bot]' ] && [ "$(git log -1 --format=%an)" != 'github-actions[bot]' ] && exit 0 || exit 1
